content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Stock photos

PayPal, Stripe, Gumroad, and Lemon Squeezy are popular platforms for selling digital products, but they come with significant limitations. PayPal accounts can be suspended, holding funds for up to 180 days with no appeal, while Stripe's restricted countries list includes many popular markets. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy, while user-friendly, charge high fees and lack customization options. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure solutions like the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) offer a robust, customizable, and cost-effective alternative for selling digital products.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Gumroad's payout delays, Payhip's withdrawal restrictions, and Lemon Squeezy's geographic unavailability all stem from the same root cause: these platforms operate within the traditional financial system. They process payments through Stripe or PayPal on the backend, which means they inherit every restriction those processors impose. When Stripe does not support your country, Gumroad cannot pay you out — regardless of what the platform's feature list implies. Paddle operates as a merchant of record, which creates additional compliance requirements that make it functionally unavailable in most of Africa, South Asia, and Latin America. These are not platform-level problems. They are financial system problems that only infrastructure built outside that system can solve.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

NOWPayments operates as a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 cryptocurrencies including Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT on multiple chains, Solana, BNB on Binance Smart Chain, and Tron. When a buyer initiates payment, NOWPayments creates a unique payment address for that specific transaction, monitors the blockchain in real time, and fires a webhook when payment confirms on-chain. The 0.5% fee is the only cost — no monthly fee, no setup fee, no revenue share, no payout schedule. Funds go directly to the wallet addresses you configure. COREMERCH never touches your wallet or your funds at any point before, during, or after deployment.
Traditional payment platforms like PayPal and Stripe charge high fees, ranging from 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

The asymmetric risk of platform dependency becomes concrete only when the platform acts. While a PayPal or Stripe account is functioning normally, the risk feels theoretical and distant. When it stops functioning — through suspension, policy change, or geographic restriction enforcement — the creator loses their revenue channel instantly, often with funds already inside the platform that cannot be withdrawn. The conventional appeals process rarely reverses these decisions because the original decision was made algorithmically and the human review process operates on the platform's timeline and criteria, not yours. Sovereign infrastructure eliminates this asymmetry entirely. Your Cloudflare Pages storefront cannot be suspended by a payment processor's compliance decision. Your wallet cannot be frozen by anyone.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choosing the right architecture for selling digital products depends on your specific needs and circumstances. If you require a customizable and cost-effective solution, sovereign commerce infrastructure is the clear choice. If you're looking for a user-friendly interface and don't mind high fees, traditional payment platforms like Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy may be suitable. Ultimately, the key is to evaluate your options carefully and choose the solution that best meets your needs.

The most important question to ask is: What architecture will allow me to sell digital products freely, regardless of my location? The answer is clear: sovereign commerce infrastructure solutions like the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) provide a permanent structural alternative at the base layer, ensuring that sellers can operate freely, regardless of their location. With complete ownership and control over digital products, automated delivery, and customer data, sellers can focus on creating and delivering high-quality digital products, without worrying about platform restrictions or fees.

Your Deployment Checklist

Accept that no workaround inside conventional payment infrastructure is durable — platforms actively close gaps as they discover them. Create a NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as your starting point — these cover the widest range of buyers in restricted markets. Choose your stack: Stack 01 for a self-deployed free setup using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, Stack 02 for the Edge Stack deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint URL in your IPN settings pointing to your backend. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the full pipeline: webhook received, transaction verified on-chain, order logged, delivery email sent, download link working. Share your store URL only after the mainnet test passes cleanly.
